title_zh: 试行先匿名写意见再自愿讨论

scenario.label_zh: 试行先匿名写意见再自愿讨论
scenario.goal_zh: 指出公开排名可能妨碍发言，并约定用匿名意见和自愿讨论试行新的反馈方式

context_zh: 团队复盘会上，两位项目负责人商量让较少发言的同事也能表达具体意见。
author: author-phase11-b

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: Only three people spoke in yesterday's review. Did the public ranking put everyone else off?

sentences.speaker: Marcus
sentences.text: It might have. Being asked to defend your score in front of the team can inhibit honest feedback.

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: I don't think silence is an inherent feature of this team. People send me useful comments afterwards.

sentences.speaker: Marcus
sentences.text: Then let's give everyone a private way to contribute before we meet. Their involvement shouldn't depend on enjoying a debate.

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: Would anonymous written comments followed by an optional discussion work?

sentences.speaker: Marcus
sentences.text: Yes. Ask for one specific problem and one possible change, so the feedback is meaningful rather than just a score.

sentences.speaker: Ada
sentences.text: Let's try that next week, without the public ranking, and ask people how the format felt.
